title: AdaLN Guidance (自适应层归一化引导)

standard.summary: 在 DiT 的 Adaptive Layer Normalization 调制信号上添加可学习偏置，实现对条件信号强度的细粒度控制。
standard.effect: adaln_guidance_init_scale=0.0 表示初始不改变 AdaLN 行为，训练中逐渐学习合适的偏置。
standard.whenToUse: DiT 架构（Anima/Newbie）中想微调条件信号的影响强度时。
standard.avoidWhen: 非 DiT 架构不需要。

standard_en.summary: Adds a learnable bias on the DiT's Adaptive Layer Normalization modulation signal, giving fine-grained control over the strength of the conditioning.
standard_en.effect: adaln_guidance_init_scale=0.0 means AdaLN behaviour is unchanged at the start and a suitable bias is learned as training goes on.
standard_en.whenToUse: On DiT architectures (Anima / Newbie) when you want to tune how strongly the conditioning signal acts.

advanced.principle: DiT 使用 AdaLN 将时间步和条件信号调制成 scale/shift/gate 三组参数。adaln_guidance 在调制信号上叠加一个可学习偏置向量 Δ = init_scale × learnable_params，使模型可以在不改变主干的情况下微调条件控制强度。这比重新训练 AdaLN 层更轻量。
advanced.intervention: 在 DiT block 的 AdaLN modulation 输出上叠加偏置。
advanced.expectedImpact: 允许更精细的条件控制。参数量很少（每层一个偏置向量）。
advanced.tradeoffs: adaln_guidance_init_scale 控制初始影响强度。0 表示从零开始学习。

advanced_en.principle: DiT uses AdaLN to modulate the timestep and condition signals into scale/shift/gate parameter groups. adaln_guidance overlays a learnable bias vector Δ = init_scale × learnable_params on the modulation signal, letting the model fine-tune condition-control strength without touching the backbone. Lighter than retraining the AdaLN layers.
advanced_en.intervention: Overlays the bias on the AdaLN modulation output of each DiT block.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Enables finer condition control. Very few parameters (one bias vector per layer).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: adaln_guidance_init_scale controls the initial influence strength. 0 = learn from zero.
